title: Merkle Trees is the Perfect Place for UTXOs: Floresta as a Chain Source for BDK
description:
📌 Learn more about this talk on GitHub: ⭐️🐙
https://github.com/TABConf/7.tabconf.com/issues/33

🌱🧰 Explore bdk-floresta
A work in progress BDK chain source crate that uses floresta-chain + floresta-wire to run a local, trustless node and wallet directly on your device 📲🧱
Perfect for mobile and low spec setups ⚡️

🧠 What this talk covers
🌳 Utreexo 101
Merkle proofs, validation, and bridge nodes
🔍 How Floresta leverages Utreexo and how it differs from utreexod
🏗️ A clear BDK architecture overview
🎬 Live demo
Creating and syncing a wallet using the crate ✅

🎯 If you’re a dev or a Bitcoin enthusiast who wants lightweight, self contained wallets that can run anywhere, this one’s for you 🛠️🟠

⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️⚡️🛠️

🟠 TABConf is a technical Bitcoin conference built for builders. We bring protocol + application devs together to collaborate, debate, and push Bitcoin forward. 🧠🔧
